messages.subject: Planned DMS maintenance - Saturday 14 March
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system will be unavailable this Saturday 14 March from 07:00 to 11:00 for scheduled maintenance. Please save and close all documents beforehand. Email is unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
